title: The Extra Shadow on Stage
central_conflict: an unexpected shadow spoiled the village play
decisive_choice: a painted scenery panel was hanging in front of the backstage lamp
resolution: raised the panel and rehearsed the lighting again
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered an unexpected shadow spoiled the village play before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they moved the spotlight but the shadow followed the performers; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a painted scenery panel was hanging in front of the backstage lamp; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they raised the panel and rehearsed the lighting again, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Bakery Bell That Rang Twice

resolution: fastened the sign and tested the bell with the delivery team

Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a swinging sign struck the bell on the return stroke; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

title: The Snow Trail That Disappeared
central_conflict: the rescue team's trail markers vanished overnight
decisive_choice: wind from the narrow pass had piled snow against the markers
resolution: moved the route to a sheltered ridge and recorded its landmarks
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the rescue team's trail markers vanished overnight before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they set larger flags but the next morning those were buried too; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized wind from the narrow pass had piled snow against the markers; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they moved the route to a sheltered ridge and recorded its landmarks, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
